title: MARL-BattleGrounds: A Novel JAX-native Benchmark for Heterogeneous and Competitive Multi-agent RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.14883v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present MARL-BattleGrounds (MARL-BGs), an easy-to-use JAX-native benchmark for heterogeneous and competitive multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), designed to be sample-efficient, computationally efficient, and researcher-centric. MARL benchmarks are typically simple and efficient, like SMAX, where winning reduces to unit micromanagement, or rich and costly, like Dota 2. MARL-BGs fills this missing middle. Its first mode, Team Deathmatch, is a simultaneous turn-based game between two teams of five heterogeneous agents. The five classes have distinct basic, passive, and ultimate abilities designed to synergize with allies and counter enemies. Our 52 hand-designed maps with diverse obstacles include a 12-map curriculum and ten held-out validation and test maps. MARL-BGs provides two canonical evaluation modes. translated_title: MARL-BattleGrounds：一个用于异构竞争性多智能体强化学习的全新JAX原生基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了MARL-BattleGrounds（MARL-BGs），这是一个易于使用的JAX原生基准测试平台，面向异构竞争性多智能体强化学习（MARL），其设计注重样本效率、计算效率和以研究者为中心。现有的MARL基准测试通常要么简单高效（如SMAX，其胜负归结为单位的微观操作），要么内容丰富但计算成本高昂（如Dota 2），而MARL-BGs恰好填补了这一缺失的中间地带。其第一种模式“团队死斗”是一个由两支各含五名异构智能体的队伍进行的同步回合制游戏。五种职业拥有独特的基础、被动和终极技能，这些技能旨在与队友产生协同效应并克制敌方。我们手工设计了52张包含多样障碍物的地图，其中包括一个由12张地图组成的课程学习序列以及十张保留的验证和测试地图。MARL-BGs提供两种标准评估模式：其一，八个残局场景构成了一项困难的泛化挑战，每个场景要求队伍在未见过的、几乎必败的劣势局面中反败为胜。
tldr: 该论文提出了MARL-BattleGrounds，一个高效且易于使用的JAX原生异构竞争性多智能体强化学习基准，通过团队死斗游戏模式和残局泛化挑战填补了简单基准（如SMAX）与昂贵复杂基准（如Dota 2）之间的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MARL-BattleGrounds, an efficient, easy-to-use JAX-native benchmark for heterogeneous and competitive multi-agent RL, which fills the gap between simple benchmarks like SMAX and costly complex ones like Dota 2 through its Team Deathmatch mode and endgame generalization challenges.
